svg.aria-label: Bode plots of the quadratic factor 1 over 1 minus u squared plus j 2 zeta u, with u = omega over omega n, for zeta = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5 and 1: low damping gives a tall resonant peak near u = 1; all curves fall at 40 dB per decade above the corner; every phase curve passes minus 90 degrees at u = 1 and ends at minus 180
svg.title: Bode plots of the quadratic factor 1 over 1 minus u squared plus j 2 zeta u, with u = omega over omega n, for zeta = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5 and 1: low damping gives a tall resonant peak near u = 1; all curves fall at 40 dB per decade above the corner; every phase curve passes minus 90 degrees at u = 1 and ends at minus 180

g.text: the asymptote (dashed) ignores ζ; near the corner the exact curve depends strongly on damping
